description: An abstract base controller class for API endpoints, providing methods to generate JSON responses and error responses with appropriate headers and status codes.

classes.name: BaseController
classes.description: An abstract controller class providing common response generation functionalities for API responses.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Generates a JSON HTTP response with the given response data, status code, and appropriate headers.

methods.name: generateErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates an error response based on an exception, sets relevant details, and returns a JSON HTTP response with error information.
